1573-09-09.summary: Mondoucet reports to Charles IX on Alba's siege of Alkmaar (it can be assaulted from one place only), Alba's recall by the King of Spain, Medinaceli, the King of Poland's passage and Danzig, and a letter from France predicting things greater than St Bartholomew's Day. The Court's verbatim decipherment on ff. 139-141 was typed and aligned against the cipher; the tail (f. 137v against f. 141r) was compared by length only and is not transcribed.

1573-01-04.summary: Mondoucet's report from Antwerp on German captains raising men, Alba's wartgeld with the Duke of Brunswick and Saxe-Lauenburg, a hundred thousand crowns at Hamburg, and an Irish bishop kept at Antwerp by Alba for the Ireland practice. No contemporary decipherment survives; the project decoded it ciphertext-only to about 55-60% of letters.

1572-07-13.summary: No contemporary decipherment and not in Didier; with the 1572 key fitted on the 16 July crib only scattered words read (about 1-8% of glyphs). The decryption file is the verbatim beam output of the retry.

system: Homophonic substitution of invented and letter-form signs (one glyph per letter, 24-letter alphabet) with a few digraph and word signs and nulls, inline in clear French.
